Headline: #39 Pershing Temporary Reroute near Archer/Western
ShortDescription: #39 Pershing buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Archer/Western.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#39 Pershing buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Archer/Western.

Westbound buses will operate via Pershing, Damen, 35th, Leavitt, Orange Line terminal and over normal route.

Eastbound buses will operate via Orange Line terminal, Archer, 35th, Damen, Pershing and over normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: O'Hare-bound Blue Line Service Delayed at Irving Park
ShortDescription: O'Hare-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Irving Park due to police activity. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
O'Hare-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Irving Park due to police activity.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#53 Pulaski
#80 Irving Park
#78 Montrose

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
